FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE
THE order under Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), as amended by Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amended byActs, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, Susil Premajayantha,Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy do by this order declare the Dammantotaroda Forest of 1361.7126 hectaresbounded by the limit setforth in the schedule hereto as Dammantotaroda Reserved Forest from 31st day of December, 2014.
SUSIL PREMAJAYANTHA,Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy.
Ministry of Environment and Renewable Energy,Battaramulla,05th December, 2014.
